statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
There is concern for an underlying paroxysmal arrhythmia
The service is to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, G45.9, and R00.2
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
